title: Gatebraid Codex consult record (gatebraid/consult@1)
description: Metadata for one read-only Codex consultation (ADR-0004): the request the Lead wrote, the Consultant's fixed-schema response, and the Lead's recorded decision. The consult and response files are committed; linking follows scope (ADR-0021 §4) — a slice-scoped consult is linked from its Slice issue, a non-slice consult by citation from the documents that adopted its outcome. Evidence travels embedded in the request because the Consultant cannot execute.

consult_id.description: CONSULT-<issue#>-<seq> for a slice-scoped consult; CONSULT-M<n>-<seq> for a milestone-level one (ADR-0021 §3). The form is not free: the root conditional binds it to the trigger's scope.

slice_id.description: Required exactly when the trigger is slice-scoped, and absent otherwise (ADR-0021 §2). architecture-decision and human-request are not slice-scoped.

fingerprint_before.description: Semantic Git fingerprint before the consult.

fingerprint_after.description: Semantic Git fingerprint after applying (or declining) the outcome.

constraints.description: Constraints and forbidden operations, from the project's prohibited-operations overlay.

embedded_evidence.description: Section anchors in the consult file where command outputs (test logs, stack traces, diffs) are embedded.

recommended_change.description: Patch sketch as suggestion text — the Consultant cannot and must not apply anything.

independently_verified.description: The Lead reproduced the reasoning / ran the verification steps before applying anything. Blind-apply is prohibited (ADR-0004 §3).

rebuttal_rounds.description: Maximum one structured rebuttal round each.
